_comment: B2 spec/eval pilot (decisions/0011, UD1). Scoped to the three pure pilot functions ONLY -- validateSecurityTxt, validateLlmsTxt, validateFeedJson (175 LOC total). The rest of each mutated file (main(), checkPresence, validateFeedXml -- all network-path plumbing or explicitly out of pilot scope) is bracketed with '// Stryker disable all' / '// Stryker restore all' comments so it is never mutated in the first place, rather than mutated-and-ignored via a NoCoverage carve-out. This is what makes the mutation gate carry the pilot's sufficiency claim (§2 DR2) rather than being diluted by untested network code. thresholds.break=70 is the measured floor (72.31% observed across repeated runs on 2026-07-29), with a small buffer for one borderline UpdateOperator infinite-loop mutant near the vitest per-test timeout. Known, accepted survivors: ~22 StringLiteral mutants on message text (never asserted -- only {id, severity} pairs are part of the spec contract); ~28 Regex mutants on boundary variants the declared case set does not discriminate; a handful on validate-llms-txt.mjs's currentSection.isOptional, which is assigned but never read by any code path (pre-existing, out-of-pilot-scope) -- an equivalent mutant no test could ever kill. Raise thresholds.break as cases are added; do not lower it to make a regression pass.
